title: Tradition (locale)
description: A tradition's name in one language, plus the official titles of its calendar lines, the labels of its observances and of its symbols (data/i18n/<locale>/traditions/<id>.json). Official titles are quotes: keep them as the Church prints them, only normalizing diacritics.

official_titles.description: Title of each calendar line, keyed by the line's first commemoration.

observances.description: Labels of the tradition's observances, keyed by observance id.

symbols.description: Labels of the symbol_legend entries, keyed by symbol key.
